prescopes:
namespace AddSubgroup

open Function

variable {G A : Type*} [Group G] [AddGroup A] [DistribMulAction G A]
informal_statement: For any element \( a \) in a group \( G \) and any additive subgroup \( S \) of an abelian group \( A \), the index of the subgroup \( a \cdot S \) is equal to the index of \( S \) itself. In other words, scaling a subgroup by a group element does not change its index.
informal_proof:
To establish that the index of \( a \cdot S \) is equal to the index of \( S \), we can leverage the bijectivity of the scaling map induced by the group element \( a \). Consider the map that sends each element \( s \) in \( S \) to \( a \cdot s \). This map is both injective and surjective, hence bijective, meaning it preserves the structure of \( S \).

Since the scaling map is bijective, it establishes a one-to-one correspondence between the cosets of \( S \) and the cosets of \( a \cdot S \). As a result, the number of distinct cosets remains unchanged, implying that the index of \( a \cdot S \) is the same as the index of \( S \).

Therefore, we conclude that \( (a \cdot S).index = S.index \), as required.

id.name: AddSubgroup.index_smul
id.content:
lemma index_smul (a : G) (S : AddSubgroup A) : (a • S).index = S.index :=
  index_map_of_bijective _ (MulAction.bijective _)
id.compilationAlias:
lemma index_smul (a : G) (S : AddSubgroup A) : (a • S).index = S.index :=
  index_map_of_bijective _ (MulAction.bijective _)
